faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Which photos, and where do I send them?
faq.a1: 3–10 clear photos of the face in good light, without filters or glasses. After the request, the manager writes on Telegram — send the photos there.
faq.a2: Usually a week. Sooner: +20% for each day saved. The shortest time is 1 day, which is +120%.
faq.a3: One free revision. Further ones are agreed separately.
faq.a4: 50% up front, the rest on delivery. Click, Payme, card transfer, or invoice.
faq.a5: Finish the quiz and leave a request. The discount stays with that order.
faq.a6: A manager is here from 9:00 to 18:00. Evening and night requests are taken in the morning.
faq.a7: They are used only for your order. They appear in examples only with your consent.

privacy.p1: Jonlix AI Studio takes orders for photos, video, and digital work. For that we need your name, phone, and, if you add them, a Telegram name and a comment.
privacy.p2: The request is stored in our server database and copied to a Google Sheet. A manager receives it on Telegram in order to reply.
privacy.p3: You send photographs later, in the chat with the manager. The site does not upload files. We do not publish your photos without consent.
privacy.p4: The site remembers the language, the quiz draft, and ad labels in your browser, so you do not have to start the form again and we can see where the visit came from.
privacy.p5: You can write on Telegram and ask us to delete a request. We will remove it from the working sheet and the chat, as far as that is in our hands.
privacy.p6: By pressing “Get a price” or “Send the request”, you agree to this use of your details for the order.
